programmes.name_local: صندوق العمل تمكين - برنامج دعم الأعمال
programmes.amount_note: Co-matching grants covering a share (commonly 50%, higher for some categories) of equipment, marketing, digital tools, consultancy and business development costs for Bahraini enterprises. Ceilings vary by enterprise size and are published per programme.
programmes.deadline_note: Rolling applications through the Tamkeen portal; individual programmes open and close as budgets are allocated each year.
programmes.reopen_note: Tamkeen restructures its programme portfolio annually; when a programme closes, an equivalent successor is normally launched in the new fiscal year on tamkeen.bh.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the enterprise on the Tamkeen portal.
Submit quotations and the business case.
Approval, then reimbursement or direct payment to the supplier.

eligibility.other_note: Bahraini-registered enterprises; many programmes require Bahraini ownership and prioritise Bahraini employment.

programmes.amount_note: Six months of hands-on support across commercialisation, product development, fundraising and team development. The programme is fully funded by Tamkeen; there is no published cash grant to participants.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based; intake windows are announced on tamkeen.bh.
programmes.reopen_note: Tamkeen runs Riyada cohorts periodically with partner operators (including a track powered by Salica Investments for tech entrepreneurs); new cohorts are announced on the Tamkeen programmes page.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online during an open cohort window.

documents_required.doc: Bahraini CR or commitment to register

eligibility.other_note: Bahrain-based startups; the programme is fully supported by Tamkeen.

programmes.source_snippet: The program offers hands-on and practical support over the course of six months in four main areas: commercialization, product development, fundraising, and team development.

programmes.amount_note: Financing of up to BHD 1 million. Tamkeen reimburses 50% of the profit rate up to 4% for SMEs (50% up to 2% for large enterprises); for focus-sector startup SMEs borrowing up to BHD 30,000 repaid within seven years the same 50%/4% subsidy applies. Tenor up to 7 years.

procedure_steps.detail: Onboard to the Playbook mentorship platform and complete 3 mentorship sessions.
BDB and Tamkeen approve; funding follows.

eligibility.other_note: Business owned and fully managed by a Bahraini woman (at least 51% of share capital if a company), based in Bahrain, active commercial registration; must complete the mentorship programme on the Playbook platform before funding.

programmes.source_snippet: Applicants for the program may be able to attain up to BHD 1 million in financing, dependent on need and suitability.

programmes.amount_note: Sharia-compliant financing with repayment of up to five years and a profit subsidy of up to 50%; amount set by the business's needs and financial assessment. Priority sectors: tourism, manufacturing, logistics, IT and digital economy, finance, health, education.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications opened on 10 November 2025 at BDB's main branch.

eligibility.other_note: SMEs with an active commercial registration operating for at least two years.

programmes.source_snippet: The SME Fund provides Sharia’a-compliant financing with flexible repayment terms of up to five years.

programmes.amount_note: Financing for registered Bahraini SMEs with a grace period of up to 12 months and repayment up to 5 years at competitive profit rates.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications were open for a limited time, 10 May to 10 June 2026.
programmes.reopen_note: Watch the BDB page for the next window.

eligibility.other_note: Registered SME in Bahrain with a valid CR in operation for at least 36 months; subject to BDB credit approval.

programmes.source_snippet: Key features of Sanad include a grace period of up to 12 months and repayment period of up to 5 years.

programmes.name_local: SME Fund Financing under Tamkeen's Musanada Programme
programmes.name_en: SME Fund Financing under Tamkeen's Musanada Programme
programmes.amount_note: SME Fund financing with Tamkeen paying 100% of the profit for up to the first 12 months, for micro, small and medium enterprises in financial or operational distress.
programmes.reopen_note: Watch the BDB page for any reopening.

eligibility.other_note: Active CR or licence issued before March 2026; MSME per the Ministry of Industry and Commerce classification; must show financial or operational distress while committed to business continuity; no Tamkeen or LMRA violations.

programmes.source_snippet: Tamkeen providing 100% profit subsidy for up to the first 12 months.

programmes.amount_note: Sharia-compliant subsidised financing: Tamkeen subsidises part of the financing profit up to an approved cap, through partner banks.

eligibility.other_note: Micro, small or medium enterprise with an active CR from MOIC (or a regulator licence), no violations with Tamkeen or LMRA; apply through a partner bank.

programmes.source_snippet: We will subsidize part of the financing profit up to the approved cap amount.

programmes.amount_note: Tamkeen pays the cost of access to digital tools from partner providers for the approved support period.

eligibility.other_note: Virtual, micro, small or medium enterprise with an active CR from MOIC (or regulator licence) and no violations with Tamkeen, LMRA or other government entities. Apply through Tamkeen's online portal.

programmes.source_snippet: We will support the cost of the access to the digital tool (from our defined partners) up to the approved support time.
